composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. creative_direction: Create a stepped concrete terrace descending toward a calm coast. Arrange the terraces as broad horizontal layers across the lower scene, with one diagonal stair connecting them. A narrow band of still sea sits behind the structure, while open pale sky occupies the top. Show only a few damp edges and salt traces. Avoid beach crowds or additional buildings. Use clean environmental illustration. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
